default_density_guidance: commonly zero; occasional single individual; multiple individuals should be uncommon unless user opts in

morphology.authority: Tross et al. 2022, Journal of Experimental Biology, DOI 10.1242/jeb.243930

extended_visual_span_mm.note: Use as total displayed footprint constraint; do not enlarge or shrink solely for recognizability.

locomotion.forward_gait: coordinated alternating tetrapod with frequent microstops
locomotion.backward_gait: inverted/modified alternating tetrapod; escape can be much faster
locomotion.upside_down_gait: slower, less rigid coordination, more legs in stance
notes: Do not transfer spider or ant gait.
Second leg pair showed particularly long stance / short swing and is important for stability.
Exact display-glass traction remains an engineering/surface-transfer gap.

predation.argentine_ant_specific_evidence: not directly measured in this research pass
predation.realistic_mode_rule: Allow close-range predator interaction, but keep Argentine-ant-specific pursuit/kill/handling/preference constants gated until directly supported.

life_history.screen_population_rule: Growth in visible predators should be via rare arrivals/emergence, not compressed reproduction.
